reason: A terminal-native ACP client and TUI plugin for running DeepSeek Harness or compatible agents, with streaming conversations, tool and subagent views, persistent sessions, image prompts, local shell commands, and extensible UI contributions.

summaries.zh: 在终端中运行 DeepSeek Harness 或兼容 ACP 智能体，提供流式会话、工具调用展示、持久化会话、图片提示和可扩展界面。
summaries.en: Run DeepSeek Harness or compatible ACP agents in a terminal with streaming sessions, tool-call views, persistent conversations, image prompts, and extensible UI contributions.

capabilities: Runs a terminal user interface for DeepSeek Harness and ACP agents
Displays streaming reasoning, responses, tool calls, subagent activity, and token metrics
Supports persistent sessions, follow-up and steering interactions
Accepts local and clipboard images in prompts
Executes session-level local shell commands via !cmd
Supports extensible themes, commands, overlays, UI presets, and dynamic plugins
